_comment: Payouts of the generic dungeon runner. Gold and XP are paid on every win; items (the dungeon's pack, cards) only on the champion's first win of that room (one claim per champion, kept across runs). 'rooms' maps a DungeonTemplate room title (m_Title) to its battle's reward, or to a list with one reward per battle of the room; 'pack': true grants the dungeon's pack from 'packs' (DungeonTemplate name -> chest template GUID), 'card_guid' a card. A room without an entry pays by win order: 'battles' is indexed by the order in which a run's battles are won (1st win, 2nd win, ...; the last entry repeats) and 'boss' is the finale room's battle, which also grants the pack. A dungeon entry may override 'battles'/'boss'/'rooms'. Values: HEX Revival progression notes (videos), github.com/Theveninm/Hex-shard-of-fates-revival docs/PROGRESSION.md and Progression.cs. Castle Crayburn has its own runner and is not affected.

The Tranquil Dream._source: Gold/XP by the rank of the creature beaten (the run's win order) and Sister Midnight with the Tranquil Dream Pack (first win only).

Fort Romor._source: Per foe (video); the Defense's three battles in order, the pack with Lord Adam.

The Usurper._source: Per room (video); Finanif at the Shepherd's Rest is PLACEHOLDER (Revival PLACEHOLDERS.md: never fought on video).

The Smoldering Dead._source: Per room (video; values by room as in Revival Progression.cs, foe labels cosmetic); the Ancient Thorn Knight gives Voracious Vultures (AZ1 PvE set) on the first win.

Devonshire Keep._source: Per room (video); the Oratory pays the same for the knight (H1) and the zombies (H2).
